The app and its web interface now darken the accent by the same rule.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The accent ink agreed with the web interface on yellow and on nothing else.** 1.6.0 darkened the accent for the light theme by stepping it toward black until it cleared the readability threshold against white — which is arithmetically the better rule and the wrong one to use here, because the CSS side has no way to express it. The two agreed on Sunflower and diverged on every other preset: Blue stopped at `#1D7CC5` in the app where the web interface lands on `#105486`. One design language means one rule, so the app follows the CSS: 55% of the way to black (GlimStone 1.5.0). Sunflower is unchanged; the other four presets now match the web interface exactly.

## 📋 Notes

- Nothing else changed. This is 1.6.0's own light-theme fix, made to agree with its siblings.
